segments.t: Chief producer Kim Tae-ho announces the assignments for the new rookies. Although Baek Seung-chan hoped for Entertainment Weekly, he gets placed in a struggling team. Listen for "iljimang", 'first choice', and "sinip", 'rookie'.
그 팀 지금 분위기가 뭐 그렇게 좋진 않을 거야.
가서 네가 선배님들 기분 좀 업시켜 드리고.
Let's listen to Tae-ho crush Seung-chan's dreams line by line.
Tae-ho starts with excitement. He says "deudieo", 'finally', and "eommu baejeonghaneun narida", 'it is task assignment day'.
He calls the next rookie. He says "geu daeumeun", 'next is'.
He reads Seung-chan's application. He uses "iljimang", 'first choice'.
He sounds impressed. He says "teugihane", 'it is unique', and "giteukhae", 'admirable'.
He praises the rookie's bravery. He says "sinipi", 'a rookie', and "nega cheoeumiya", 'you are the first'.
Seung-chan bows proudly. He says "yeolsimhi hagesseumnida", 'I will do it diligently', the standard office pledge.
Tae-ho pulls the rug out. He says "geurae", 'alright', and assigns him to "ilbak iil", the show 2 Days and 1 Night.
그 팀 지금 분위기가 뭐 그렇게 좋진 않을 거야.
He gives a subtle warning. He mentions the "bunwigi", 'atmosphere', saying it is not "jojin aneul geoya", 'probably not good'.
가서 네가 선배님들 기분 좀 업시켜 드리고.
He gives the rookie an impossible task. He tells him to "gaseo", 'go', and "gibun jom eopsikyeo deurigo", 'raise their mood'. Now let's hear the brutal assignment again.
그 팀 지금 분위기가 뭐 그렇게 좋진 않을 거야.
가서 네가 선배님들 기분 좀 업시켜 드리고.
The word "iljimang" is very common when applying to schools or jobs. Keep practicing and you'll catch more of these details!
